title: Compact Acoustic Drum Kit
description: One original static low-poly compact acoustic drum kit, counted as one prop: a horizontal bass drum with a genuinely perforated thick front head, a separate open-bottom snare drum, one open-bottom mounted tom, and one formed thick cymbal on an independent fixed tripod stand. Each drum has a real hollow thick shell, separate finite-thickness heads, two open hoops and restrained tension lugs. The snare has a fixed basket and tripod, the tom has an exterior fixed mount, and the bass has two short spurs plus a rear support foot. All components have documented finite fixed connections and ground paths. No solid cylinder substitutes for a drum cavity.
